description: Unit test class for testing database migration and search functionality in the org.fdroid.database package, specifically focusing on case insensitivity and diacritic sensitivity in FTS (Full-Text Search).

classes.name: FtsCaseInsensitiveMigrationTest
classes.description: Test class for database migration and search functionality, focusing on case and diacritic sensitivity.

methods.name: testMigration
methods.description: Main test method that creates a database, inserts test data, performs migration, and verifies search behavior and data integrity post-migration.

methods.name: assertSearch
methods.description: Helper method to execute a full-text search query and assert the number of results matches the expected count.

methods.name: assertGetAppListItems
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve app list items via DAO and assert the expected number of items.
